briefing: Stocks rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.3% and the S&P 500 up 1.6%, a clear risk-on session. Following our rule of putting spare cash to work on strong up days, we are using the remaining ~$646 to start a position in ANT, the only candidate that meets all four of our confirmation signals. All seven existing positions stay open, with their automatic profit targets and stop-losses still in place.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking whether a price move comes with heavier-than-usual trading. When a stock rises on volume well above its average, as ANT did today at more than 1.5 times its 20-day average, it suggests large investors are behind the move, so it is more likely to last than a rise on light trading. That is why we used the volume surge to pick ANT over other candidates whose momentum signals looked similar.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指觀察股價變動時，成交量是否明顯高於平日水平。若股價在放量下上升，例如ANT今日成交量超過20日平均的1.5倍，往往代表有大型資金參與，升勢較量縮的反彈更具持續性。正因如此，我們以成交量急增作為關鍵依據，在動能訊號相近的眾多候選股中選擇了ANT。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today, and the tech-heavy NASDAQ (+2.3%) outpaced the S&P 500 (+1.6%), which shows investors were willing to take on more risk. The rally was wide: semiconductors, optical networking, miners and large-cap tech such as AMZN, TSLA and INTC all showed bullish MACD crossovers with prices above their 20-day averages. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this explanation relies only on the price and momentum data rather than citing a particular catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數大漲2.3%，表現優於標普500指數的1.6%，反映市場風險胃納明顯回升。升勢遍及各板塊，半導體、光通訊、礦業股以至亞馬遜、特斯拉、英特爾等大型科技股，均出現MACD黃金交叉，股價亦企穩20日均線之上。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及動能數據，並無引述特定消息催化因素。

trades.reasoning: ANT is the only top candidate that meets all four confirmation signals: RSI 61.5 in the bullish zone, a rising MACD crossover, price well above its 20-day average, and a volume surge, which points to institutional buying on a strong risk-on day.
